subject.title: fix(agents): avoid synthetic overflow in tool-heavy sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt provider-authoritative whole-session overflow recovery and expose `contextOverflowRecoveryOwner` in the public session SDK for the embedded runner to coordinate it?
rationale: The evidence supports the reported bug fix, but choosing between an internal coordination seam and a supported plugin-SDK option sets the durable recovery and extension contract.

options.title: Approve the policy and SDK option
options.body: Accept provider rejection as the authority for destructive recovery and retain the additive SDK option with explicit contract coverage.

options.title: Keep ownership internal
options.body: Preserve the provider-authoritative behavior but refactor the recovery-owner coordination so plugins do not receive a new public session option.

options.title: Pause for a narrower design
options.body: Retain the existing behavior until agents owners select a bounded architecture for cross-layer overflow recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep ownership internal
recommendation.body: Preserve the provider-authoritative behavior but refactor the recovery-owner coordination so plugins do not receive a new public session option.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most direct current knowledge of the proposed recovery-owner boundary and its focused proof.
